data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m in prior year reserves in 2019. This strengthening was primarily driven by large losses and increased attritional losses on the 2017 and prior underwriting years, as well as large loss activity on 2018. The 2017 year of account was particularly impacted by major natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, California wildfires, and Mexico earthquakes. The syndicate also reassessed its initial expected loss ratios and added an extra layer of caution to its loss picks, reflecting execution risk. Specific lines affected included short tail lines like US Direct and Facultative, Cargo, Yachts & Hull, UK SME, Onshore energy, and Marine Liability.
